senses.gloss: ऽधृत् -धृ + त्, latter part of comp. words, Bearing, Hariv. 6766.

धृतराष्ट्र धृत-राष्ट्र, m.
 1. The father of Duryodhana and uncle of the Pāṇḍu princes, MBh. 1, 95.
 2. A frequent proper name.

धृति धृ + ति,
 I. f.
 1. Holding, MBh. 7, 4540 (धृतिं कृ, To keep ground). []
 2. Steadiness, Nal. 6, 10.
 3. Content, Man. 10, 116.
 4. Satisfaction, Kir. 5, 35.
 5. personified, MBh. 1, 2794.
 II. m.
 1. The name of a deity, MBh. 13, 4355.
 2. A proper name.
 --Comp.

धृतिमन्त् धृति + मन्त्,
 I. adj., f. मती.
 1. Firm, Man. 7, 210.
 2. Content, MBh. 13, 3054.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Agni, 3, 14188.
 2. A proper name.
 III. f. मती, The name of a river, 6, 339.
 IV. n. The name of a division of the world, 6, 454.
धृतिमय धृति + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of content, MBh. 3, 13372.
धृत- + व्रत धृत- + व्रत, adj. attached, faithful, Rām. 3, 2, 18.
धृत- + संकल्प धृत- + संकल्प, adj., f. पा, resolved (to, with loc.), Chr. 45, 10.
